description: To boost footfalls at iconic landmarks such as the breathtaking hill stations of Lonavala and Mahabaleshwar, the ancient Ajanta and Ellora caves, and the serene beaches of Alibaug and Tarkarli, the chatbot would help answer questions about these destinations, things to experience, accommodations in the vicinity in English language. Overall, the chatbot will make planning a trip easier for tourists.
body_lead: Maharashtra launches AI-powered chatbot to provide information about unique destinations The chatbot would answer questions about landmarks in Maharashtra, like the hill stations of Lonavala and Mahabaleshwar, the ancient Ajanta and Ellora caves, and serene beaches of Alibaug and Tarkarli, which would boost footfalls at these destinations.
